chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Man is hidden under his tongue.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that man is hidden under his tongue?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the concept of *al-insanu makhubun tahta lisanihi*, establishing speech as the primary vessel through which the hidden inner self (*batin*) is unveiled to the external world. This maxim underscores the Shia ethical emphasis on *muraqabah* (self-monitoring), where linguistic precision serves as a direct indicator of spiritual integrity and cognitive clarity. It invites the believer to view every utterance not merely as communication, but as an act of self-revelation that exposes the true state of the soul.
